newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica says it "natural buyer" of TISA.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica says it "natural buyer" of TISA.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana Chairman Juan Villalonga said on Tuesday the telecommunications group would be the natural buyer for the state's 24 percent of Telefonica's international unit, TISA.
"The natural buyer of the 24 percent of TISA in state hands is Telefonica," Villalonga said after a presentation on Telefonica's share offer at the bourse.
Another Telefonica director said the company would start negotiations with the state on its remaining stake after Telefonica is fully privtised.
The subscription period for the full privatisation of Telefonica began on Monday. The state is selling its remaining 20.9 percent stake in the group.
